title: Unmatched home rows and NULL dimension keys form a NULL group
question: What is the sales amount by customer region?
behavior: The branch LEFT JOINs customers from store_sales. SS4 has no customer, and C3 has a NULL region; both place their amounts in the NULL region group (25 + 40). An INNER JOIN would drop them. S1; Sections 4 and 5.5.
